cases.name: mix-without-cases
cases.description: A mix with nothing to mix

cases.name: unknown-mix-child
cases.description: A tag inside <mix> that is not a case

cases.name: flag-without-anomaly
cases.description: flag= with no case marked anomalous

cases.name: a-mix-percent-entry-that-is-not-a-number
cases.description: A branch is chosen by its share, and a share that is not a number chooses nothing.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><mix name="M" percent="abc,50"><case><gen type="text" value="a"/></case><case><gen type="text" value="b"/></case></mix></env><block><line><data>${{M}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-mix-flag-is-declared-for-parent-and-stat
cases.description: parent=, of= and an expression may all name a <mix>'s flag= column; the ports used to answer TDC035 and TDC240.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="3" seed="s" local="en"><mix name="T" percent="80,20" flag="Bad"><case><gen type="number" value="20..25"/></case><case anomaly="true"><gen type="number" value="80..90"/></case></mix><sequence name="Note" parent="Bad.true"><gen type="text" value="x"/></sequence><sequence name="R"><gen type="stat" of="Bad" op="count"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Note}} ${{R}}</data></line></block></tdc>
